entries.englishValue: Would you rather save in euros that buy you less over time? Or save in Bitcoin that has historically bought you more over time?

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin transaction fees are transparent, predictable, and typically very low. Banks often have hidden fees, monthly account fees, overdraft charges, wire transfer fees, ATM fees, and other penalties that can add up significantly over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin fees are transparent and predictable. Banks stack on hidden account, overdraft, wire, and ATM fees over time.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin transakzio-komisoak gardenak, aurreikus daitezkeenak eta normalean oso baxuak dira. Bankuek askotan ezkutuko komisoak, hileroko kontu-komisoak, zorpetze gehigarriko karguak, transferentzia-komisoak, kutxazain-komisoak eta denborarekin nabarmen metatu daitezkeen beste zigorrak dituzte.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin prevents you from spending money you don't have - you can only spend Bitcoin that you actually own. Banks allow overdrafts (spending more than your account balance) and then charge substantial fees for this 'service,' often leading to cascading penalty charges.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin only lets you spend what you actually own. Banks allow overdrafts, then charge cascading penalty fees for the privilege.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek ez dizu benetan ez duzun dirua gastatzea ahalbidetzen - soilik benetan duzun Bitcoin gastatu dezakezu. Bankuek zorpetze gehigarria baimentzen dute (zure kontuko saldoa baino gehiago gastatzea) eta ondoren komisio handiak kobratzen dituzte 'zerbitzu' honengatik, askotan kaskada-zigor karguak eraginez.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek benetan duzuna baino ezin dizu gastatzeko aukera eman. Bankuek deskubertuak onartzen dituzte eta gero zerrenda bat kobratzen dizute horren truke.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin transactions are censorship resistant - once broadcast to the network, they cannot be stopped or reversed by any central authority. entries.englishValue: Once broadcast, Bitcoin transactions can't be stopped or reversed. Banks can block, freeze, or reverse transactions based on policy or government orders.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin transakzioak zentsura-erresistenteak dira - sarera igorri ondoren, ezin dira inolako autoritate zentralek gelditu edo atzera bota. entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be sent anywhere in the world instantly over the Internet, while cash requires physical presence or trusted intermediaries. You can't email cash, but you can send Bitcoin to anyone with an Internet connection in minutes.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves over the internet anywhere in minutes. Cash needs physical presence or trusted couriers — you can't email a $20 bill.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin works the same way everywhere. Cash is limited by geography, exchange rates, and local acceptance.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is the most secure computing network ever built and has never been hacked. CBDCs rely on banks and governments that have been hacked countless times.

entries.englishValue: Anyone can run a Bitcoin node to verify the rules of the network. CBDCs don't allow users to run nodes — you have to trust the central authority.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a truly decentralized network with tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Many crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small groups of developers who can make unilateral decisions about the protocol's future.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin runs on tens of thousands of independent nodes worldwide. Most crypto projects are controlled by foundations, companies, or small dev teams that can make unilateral changes.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins that will ever exist, making it the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies, inflationary mechanisms, or can mint new tokens at will, diluting holder value over time.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million coins — the scarcest digital asset. Most crypto projects have unlimited supplies or mechanisms to mint new tokens at will, diluting holders.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek 21 milioi txanponeko muga zurrun bat du inoiz existituko den guztietan, aktibo digital eskasena bihurtuz. entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek 21 milioiko muga finkoa du — ondasun digital urriena. Kripto-proiektu gehienek eskaintza mugagabea dute edo token berriak nahierara sortzeko mekanismoak, jabeak urtuz.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has one simple purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it with basic knowledge. Many crypto projects involve complex smart contracts, DeFi protocols, or governance mechanisms that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has one purpose: peer-to-peer digital money. Anyone can understand and use it. Most crypto involves complex smart contracts or DeFi that require technical expertise to use safely.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek helburu bakarra du: pertsona arteko diru digitala. Edonork uler eta erabil dezake oinarrizko ezagutzarekin. Kripto-proiektu askok kontratu adimen konplexuak, DeFi protokoloak edo gobernu-mekanismoak barneratzen dituzte, modu seguruan erabiltzeko ezagutza teknikoa behar dutenak.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek helburu bakarra du: peer-to-peer diru digitala. Edonork ulertzen du eta edonork erabil dezake. Kriptomoneta gehienek kontratu adimendun konplexuak edo DeFi-a dituzte, segurtasunez erabiltzeko ezagutza tekniko berezia eskatzen dutenak.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin uses Proof of Work consensus, which has been battle-tested for over 15 years without a single successful attack on the main network. entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's Proof of Work has run without a successful attack on the main network for over 15 years. Most crypto projects use experimental consensus that hasn't been battle-tested.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek Lanaren Froga kontsentsua erabiltzen du, 15 urte baino gehiagoz probatua sare nagusian eraso arrakastsu bakar bat gabe. entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin serves as digital money - a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are utility tokens for specific platforms, governance tokens, or speculative assets with unclear real-world value propositions.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is digital money — a store of value and medium of exchange. Most crypto tokens are speculative utility or governance tokens with unclear real-world value.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin diru digital gisa balio du - balio-gordailua eta truke-bitartekoa. Kripto-token gehienak plataforma jakin baterako utilitate-tokenak, gobernu-tokenak edo mundu errealean proposamen argirik gabeko aktibo espekulatiboak dira.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin diru digitala da — balioaren gordailua eta truke-bidea. Kripto-token gehienak espekulatiboak dira, benetako balio argirik gabeko erabilera- edo gobernantza-tokenak.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin becomes stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism thrown at it. Most crypto projects are fragile and can collapse from regulatory pressure, technical failures, or market downturns.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin grows stronger under attack and has survived every crisis, ban, and criticism. Most crypto projects collapse under regulatory, technical, or market pressure.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin erasoen aurrean indartsuagoa bihurtzen da eta inoiz bota zaion krisi, debeku eta kritika guztiei aurre egin die. Kripto-proiektu gehienak ahulak dira eta arau-presioen, hutsegite teknikoen edo merkatu-beherakadek eragin dezaketen kolapsoen aurrean erori daitezke.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin erasoaren aurrean indartzen da eta krisi, debeku eta kritika guztiak gainditu ditu. Kripto-proiektu gehienak presio arauemaile, tekniko edo merkatuaren aurrean hondoratzen dira.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company behind it, and no single point of failure. Many crypto projects are backed by venture capital firms, have identifiable leadership teams, or depend on specific companies for their continued operation.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO, no company, no single point of failure. Most crypto projects depend on VCs, specific leadership, or one company's survival.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek ez du zuzendari nagusirik, ez du enpresa bat atzean eta ez du hutsegite-puntu bakar bat. Kripto-proiektu asko arrisku-kapital enpresekin babesten dira, lidergo-talde identifikagarriak dituzte edo enpresa jakin batzuen menpe daude haien funtzionamendu jarraituari dagokionez.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek ez du CEO-rik, enpresarik edo huts-puntu bakarrik. Kripto-proiektu gehienak arrisku-kapitaleko inbertitzaileen, zuzendaritza-talde zehatz baten edo enpresa bakar baten biziraupenaren mende daude.

entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every artwork is unique — different creation, history, condition, and provenance make direct comparisons extremely difficult.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin guztiz fungiblea da, eta horrek esan nahi du bitcoin bakoitza identikoa eta trukagarria dela - bitcoin bat mundu osoan bitcoin bat da. Arte fina ez-fungiblea da izatez, pieza bakoitza bakarra izanda bere sorkuntzan, historian, egoeran eta jatorrian, zuzeneko konparazioak eta balorazioak oso zail bihurtuz.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin bakoitza berdina eta trukagarria da. Arte-lan bakoitza berezia da — jatorri, historia, egoera eta leinu ezberdinek alderaketa zuzena oso zaila egiten dute.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin trades on a global 24/7 market where anyone with internet access can buy or sell instantly. Fine art requires specialized auction houses like Sotheby's or Christie's, private dealers, or exclusive galleries. Sales can take months to arrange and complete, with limited market access and irregular trading opportunities.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades 24/7 on a global market accessible to anyone. Fine art requires specialized auction houses, private dealers, or galleries and can take months to sell.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin mundu osoko 24/7 merkatu batean negozia daiteke, non Internet sarbidea duen edonork berehala erosi edo sal dezakeen. Arte finak enkante-etxe espezializatuak behar ditu, hala nola Sotheby's edo Christie's, banatzaile pribatuak edo galeria esklusiboak. Salmentak hilabeteak behar ditzakete antolatu eta osatzeko, merkatu-sarbide mugatuarekin eta merkataritza-aukera irregularrekin.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek 24/7 merkatu global batean merkataritza egiten du, edonoren eskura. Arteak enkante-etxe, salerosle pribatu edo galeria espezializatuak behar ditu eta salmentek hilabeteak iraun ditzakete.

entries.englishValueBefore: Buying or selling bitcoin typically costs less than 1% in fees, often much less. Fine art sales involve substantial costs including buyer's premiums (10-25%), seller's commissions (10-15%), insurance, transportation, storage, and authentication fees. These combined costs can easily exceed 30-40% of the artwork's value in a single transaction.
entries.englishValue: Buying or selling Bitcoin costs under 1% in fees, often much less. Art sales rack up 30–40% in buyer's premiums, commissions, insurance, transport, and authentication fees.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin erostea edo saltzea normalean komisioetan %1 baino gutxiago kostatzen da, askotan askoz gutxiago. Arte finaren salmentek kostu handiak dakarkite, hala nola eroslearen primak (%10-25), saltzailearen komisioak (%10-15), asegurua, garraioa, biltegiratza eta autentifikazio-komisoak. Kostu konbinatu hauek erraz gainditu dezakete arte-lanaren balioaren %30-40 transakzio bakar batean.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin erostea edo saltzeak % 1 baino gutxiago kostatzen du komisioetan, maiz askoz gutxiago. Arte-salmentek % 30-40 komisioak pilatzen dituzte erosleentzat, bitartekaritzak, aseguruak, garraioak eta autentifikazio-kuotak.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size from microtransactions to large purchases. Fine art cannot be divided - you cannot own a fraction of a painting or sell just part of a sculpture. This indivisibility limits investment flexibility and liquidity options.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size transaction. You can't own a fraction of a painting or a corner of a sculpture without counterparty risk.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin 100 milioi unitate txikiagotan zati daiteke, satoshi deitzen direnak, edozein tamainako transakzioetarako ezin hobea eginez, mikro-transakzioetatik erosketa handietara. Arte fina ezin da zatitu - ezin duzu koadro baten zati bat jabe edo eskultura baten zati bat bakarrik saldu. Zatikortasun eza honek inbertsio-malgutasuna eta likidezia-aukerak mugatzen ditu.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin 100 milioi satoshitan zati daiteke, edozein tamainatako transakzioetarako ezin hobea dena. Ezin duzu margolan baten zati bat izan edo eskultura baten izkina kontrapartiaren arriskurik gabe.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified on the blockchain by anyone with basic technical knowledge. Fine art requires expensive expert authentication, provenance research, and scientific analysis. Even with expert verification, forgeries regularly fool the art world, and authentication disputes can destroy an artwork's value overnight. Bitcoin, on the other hand, cannot be forged or counterfeited.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin ownership and authenticity can be cryptographically verified by anyone on-chain. Art authentication is expensive, slow, and still routinely fooled by forgers — destroying an artwork's value overnight.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-en jabetza eta benetakotasuna kriptografikoki egiazta daiteke bloke-katean oinarrizko ezagutza teknikoa duen edonork. Arte finak aditu-autentifikazio garestia, jatorri-ikerketa eta analisi zientifikoa behar ditu. Aditu-egiaztapenarekin ere, faltsifikazioak aldizka arte-mundua engainatzen dute, eta autentifikazio-liskarrek arte-lan baten balioa gauez suntsitu dezakete. Bitcoin-a, bestalde, ezin da faltsutu edo kopiatu.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinaren jabetza eta benetakotasuna edonork egiazta ditzake kriptografikoki blockchain-ean. Artearen autentifikazioa garestia, geldoa da eta faltsifikatzaileek erregularki iruzurtzen dute — lanaren balioa gauetik goizera suntsituz.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, theft, or other disasters. Fine art is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and deterioration. Even with expensive climate-controlled storage and comprehensive insurance, artworks can be damaged by environmental factors, accidents, or natural disasters, potentially losing all value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives floods, fires, earthquakes, and theft. Fine art is vulnerable to every form of physical destruction, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-a, behar bezala babeskopiatuta dagoenean, ezin da uholdeen, suteen, lurrikaren, urakanen, lapurreten edo beste hondamendien bidez suntsitu. Arte fina suntsiketa fisikoaren eta hondatzearen forma guztien aurrean ahula da. Biltegiratzea klima-kontrolatua eta aseguru osoarekin ere, arte-lanak ingurumen-faktoreen, istripuen edo hondamendi naturalen bidez kaltetu daitezke, balio guztia galdu dezaketelarik.
entries.targetTranslation: Ongi babesturiko Bitcoinek uholdeak, suteak, lurrikarak eta lapurretak gainditzen ditu. Artea edozein hondamendi fisikoren aurrean ahula da eta aseguruak gutxitan estaltzen du dena.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold by anyone with internet access and a small amount of money to invest. Fine art investment is largely limited to wealthy collectors due to high minimum prices, exclusive auction access, storage requirements, insurance costs, and the specialized knowledge needed to navigate the art market successfully.
entries.englishValue: Anyone with an internet connection and a little money can buy Bitcoin. Fine art investment is effectively limited to wealthy collectors with auction access and specialized knowledge.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin Internet sarbidea eta inbertitzeko diru kopuru txiki bat duen edonork erosi eta sal dezake. Arte finaren inbertsioa biltzaile aberatsetara mugatuta dago neurri handi batean, prezio minimoak, enkante-sarbide esklusiboa, biltegiratzea beharrak, aseguru-kostuak eta arte-merkatuan nabigatzeko behar den ezagutza espezializatua direla eta.
entries.targetTranslation: Interneteko konexioa eta diru apur bat duen edonork eros dezake Bitcoin. Artean inbertitzea praktikan mugatuta dago enkante eta ezagutza espezializatuetarako sarbidea duten bildumagile aberatsei.

entries.englishValueBefore: Because Bitcoin is digital, it can be sent almost instantly for very low fees by anyone with an Internet connection. Because Gold is physical, it cannot be moved across the Internet and must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin can be sent instantly over the internet for low fees. Gold must be physically shipped to transfer ownership.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin digitala denez, ia berehala bidali daiteke komisio oso baxuekin Internet konexioa duen edonork. Urrea fisikoa denez, ezin da Interneten bidez mugitu eta fisikoki bidali behar da jabetza transferitzeko.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin Interneten bidez istantean bidal daiteke kuota txikiekin. Urrea fisikoki bidali behar da jabetza transferitzeko.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset, which means you can transfer full ownership of it over the Internet. Some companies offer the ability to buy gold online without receiving the actual physical gold, instead trusting the company to hold the gold for you. This is more like a Digital IOU since you only own a promise from the company instead of the actual asset.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a digitally native asset you can transfer over the internet. Online gold is a Digital IOU — you only own a promise from a custodian, not the metal itself.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin digitalki natiboa den aktiboa da, eta horrek esan nahi du jabetza osoa Interneten bidez transferitu dezakezula. Enpresa batzuek urrea online erosteko aukera eskaintzen dute benetako urre fisikoa jaso gabe, enpresari konfiantza emanez urrea zuretzat gordetzeko. Hau IOU Digital bat bezalakoa da, aktibo errealaren ordez enpresaren promesa bat besterik ez baitaukazu.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin natiboki ondasun digitala da, Internet bidez transferi dezakezuna. Sareko urrea bonu digitala da — gordetzailearen promesa baino ez duzu, ez metala bera.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a hard cap of 21 million BTC. Gold's supply grows about 1.6% per year, shrinking your slice — less than fiat
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek 21 Milioi BTC-ko muga zurrun bat du inoiz existituko den guztietan.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek 21 milioi BTC-ko muga finkoa du. Urrearen eskaintza % 1,6 hazten da urtero, zure partea txikituz — diru fiatarena baino gutxiago

entries.englishValueBefore: New gold supply is pulled out of the ground each year, resulting in inflation of the total supply. It's estimated that the total supply of gold increases by about 1.6% per year, which means your slice of the pie shrinks by 1.6% per year.
entries.englishValue: inflation
entries.currentValue: Urre-eskaintza berria lurretik ateratzen da urtero, guztizko eskaintzaren inflazioa eraginez. Urtero urrearen guztizko eskaintza %1.6 inguru handitzen dela kalkulatzen da, eta horrek esan nahi du zure tarta-zatia %1.6 txikitzen dela urtero.
entries.targetTranslation: inflazioa

entries.englishValueBefore: This is less than fiat inflation, but still inflation.
entries.englishValue: — but still inflation.
entries.currentValue: Hau fiat inflazioa baino txikiagoa da, baina oraindik ere inflazioa da.
entries.targetTranslation: , baina hala ere inflazioa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Gold has an elastic supply, meaning that as the price of gold rises, there is a greater incentive to mine more gold. This often puts downward pressure on the gold price as new mines come online.
entries.englishValue: When gold prices rise, more gold gets mined, pushing the price back down. Bitcoin's supply is inelastic — no matter how high the price goes, there will only ever be 21 million.
entries.currentValue: Urreak eskaintza elastikoa du, eta horrek esan nahi du urrearen prezioa igotzen den heinean, urre gehiago ateratzeko pizgarri handiagoa dagoela. Honek sarritan beheranzko presioa jartzen du urrearen prezioan meatzaritza berri gune berriak martxan jartzen direnean.
entries.targetTranslation: Urrearen prezioak igotzen direnean, urre gehiago meatzen da, prezioa berriro behera bultzatuz. Bitcoinaren eskaintza ez da elastikoa — prezioak gora egin arren, beti 21 milioi besterik ez dira egongo.

entries.englishValueBefore: The Bitcoin network is decentralized.
entries.englishValue: Tens of thousands of independent nodes validate the Bitcoin network. Most physical gold sits in a handful of large custodian vaults.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin sarea deszentralizatua da.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin sarea hamarnaka mila nodo independentek kontrolatzen dute. Urre fisikoaren zati handi bat biltegi handi batzuetan dago.

entries.englishValueBefore: With Bitcoin, it's incredibly easy to verify that you have real Bitcoin by taking self-custody of your coins and running a full node.
entries.englishValue: Anyone can verify real Bitcoin by running a full node — it's just an app. Verifying physical gold requires melting it down; the inside could be tungsten.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ekin, izugarri erraza da benetako Bitcoin duzula egiaztatzea zure txanponen auto-zaintza hartuz eta nodo osoa exekutatuz.
entries.targetTranslation: Edonork egiazta dezake benetako Bitcoin nodo osoa exekutatuz — aplikazio bat da besterik ez. Urre fisikoa egiaztatzeko urtu egin behar da; barruan tungstenoa egon daiteke.

entries.englishValueBefore: Just like there are 100 cents in 1 dollar, there are 100,000,000 sats in 1 Bitcoin. This enables Bitcoin to be used for all scales of purchases, including microtransactions as small as a few cents.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats, making it perfect for any size purchase. Gold can't be easily divided for small transactions.
entries.currentValue: Dolar 1ean 100 zentimo dauden bezala, Bitcoin 1ean 100.000.000 sat daude. Honek Bitcoin-ek erosketa-eskala guztietarako erabiltzeko aukera ematen du, zentimo gutxi batzuen mikro-transakzioak barne.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin 100 milioi satoshitan zati daiteke, edozein tamainatako erosketetarako ezin hobea dena. Urrea ezin da erraz zatitu transakzio txikiagoetarako.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be moved anywhere in the world instantly over the internet. Real estate is permanently fixed to a specific location and cannot be relocated, making it vulnerable to local economic conditions, natural disasters, and political instability.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin moves anywhere in the world instantly. Real estate is fixed to one location and exposed to local economic, political, and natural risks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin mundu osoan berehala mugi daiteke Interneten bidez. Higiezinak betirako kokapen zehatz bati lotuta daude eta ezin dira lekuz aldatu, tokiko baldintza ekonomikoen, hondamendi naturalen eta ezegonkortasun politikoaren aurrean ahul bihurtuz.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin istantean mugitzen da mundu osoan. Higiezinak kokapen zehatz batera lotuta daude eta arrisku ekonomiko, politiko eta ingurumenekoen aurrean zabalik.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be divided into 100 million smaller units called satoshis, making it perfect for transactions of any size. Real estate cannot be easily divided - you can't sell just the kitchen of your house or buy half a bedroom.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin divides into 100 million sats. Real estate can't be partly sold — you can't offload just the kitchen or buy half a bedroom.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin 100 milioi unitate txikiagotan zati daiteke, satoshi deitzen direnak, edozein tamainako transakzioetarako ezin hobea bihurtuz. Higiezinak ezin dira erraz zatitu - ezin duzu zure etxeko sukaldea soilik saldu edo logela erdi bat bakarrik erosi.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin 100 milioi satoshitan zati daiteke. Higiezinak ezin dira partzialki saldu — ezin duzu sukaldea saldu edo logela erdia erosi.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is subject to extensive government regulation including rent control, eviction moratoriums, zoning laws, and eminent domain where governments can seize your property.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network that no government can control. Real estate is heavily regulated — zoning, rent control, eminent domain, and seizure all apply.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin inork kontrolatu ezin duen sare deszentralizatu batean funtzionatzen du. Higiezinak gobernu-erregulazio zabalaren menpe daude, alokairu-kontrola, desahutze-moratoriak, zonifikazio-legeak eta jabari eminentea barne, non gobernuek zure jabetza konfiskatu dezaketen.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek sare deszentralizatu batean funtzionatzen du, ezein gobernuk kontrola ezin duena. Higiezinak oso erregulatuta daude — zonifikazioa, alokairuaren kontrola, nahitaezko desjabetzea eta konfiskazioa, guztiak aplikagarri dira.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin requires no maintenance - it exists as digital code on a network. Real estate requires constant upkeep including repairs, renovations, property management, insurance, and dealing with tenants if rented.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin requires no upkeep. Real estate demands repairs, renovations, insurance, property management, and tenant issues.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek ez du mantentzerik behar - sare bateko kode digital gisa existitzen da. Higiezinek etengabeko mantentzea behar dute, konponketak, berritzeak, jabetza-kudeaketa, asegurua eta alokatuz gero maizterrekin aurre egitea barne.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek ez du mantenurik behar. Higiezinek konponketak, berritzeak, aseguruak, jabetza-kudeaketa eta maizterren arazoak behar dituzte.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes - you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate is subject to annual property taxes that must be paid regardless of whether the property generates income, effectively forcing you to rent your own property from the government forever.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no ongoing taxes — you only pay capital gains when you sell. Real estate owes annual property taxes regardless of income.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek ez du zerga jarraiturik - kapital-irabazien zerga soilik ordaintzen duzu saltzen duzunean. Higiezinak urtero jabetza-zergak ordaindu behar dira, jabetzak diru-sarrerak sortzen dituen ala ez axola gabe, betirako gobernuari zure jabetza alokatzen ari zarela eraginez.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ez dago etengabe zergapetuta — kapital-irabazien zergak saltzerakoan bakarrik ordaindu behar dira. Higiezinek urteroko jabetza-zergak ordaindu behar dira, diru-sarreraren berri gabe.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin, when backed up properly, cannot be destroyed by floods, fires, earthquakes, hurricanes, or other natural disasters. Real estate is vulnerable to all forms of physical destruction and requires expensive insurance that may not fully cover losses.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin, backed up properly, survives fire, flood, and earthquake. Real estate is vulnerable to every disaster, and insurance rarely covers it all.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-a, behar bezala babeskopiatuta dagoenean, ezin da uholdeen, suteen, lurrikaren, urakanen edo beste hondamendi naturalen bidez suntsitu. Higiezinak suntsiketa fisikoaren forma guztien aurrean ahulak dira eta aseguru garestia behar dute, galerak guztiz estali ez dezakeena.
entries.targetTranslation: Ongi babesturiko Bitcoinek suteak, uholdeak eta lurrikarak gainditzen ditu. Higiezinak hondamendi guztien aurrean ahulak dira eta aseguruak gutxitan estaltzen du dena.

entries.englishValueBefore: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable - one bitcoin equals one bitcoin anywhere in the world. Every piece of real estate is unique with different locations, conditions, and characteristics, making it difficult to price and compare properties.
entries.englishValue: Every bitcoin is identical and interchangeable. Every property is unique, making pricing and comparisons difficult.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin bakoitza identikoa eta trukagarria da - bitcoin bat mundu osoan bitcoin bat da. Higiezin bakoitza bakarra da kokapen, egoera eta ezaugarri desberdinekin, jabetzak preziatzea eta konparatzea zaila bihurtuz.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin bakoitza berdina eta trukagarria da. Higiezin bakoitza berezia da, prezioa eta alderaketa zailduz.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin can be bought and sold 24/7 by anyone with internet access anywhere in the world. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers, require lengthy processes with lawyers and agents, and can take months to complete.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin trades globally 24/7 by anyone with internet access. Real estate sales are limited to local buyers and can take months of paperwork to close.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin mundu osoan 24/7 erosi eta sal daiteke Internet sarbidea duen edonork. Higiezinen salmentak tokiko erosleei mugatuta daude, prozesu luzeak behar dituzte abokatu eta agenteekin, eta hilabeteak behar ditzakete osatzeko.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek globalki 24/7 merkataritza egiten du Interneteko konexioa duen edonorentzat. Higiezinen salmentak tokiko erosleei mugatuta daude eta hilabeteak iraun ditzakete paperak ixteko.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership without intermediaries, promoting financial sovereignty for everyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence contributes to the financialization of housing, treating homes as commodities rather than shelter. This drives up prices, reduces affordability for families, and contributes to the housing and homelessness crisis affecting many countries today.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin enables direct individual ownership for anyone. Buying real estate as an investment beyond your primary residence drives up housing prices, reducing affordability and fueling the housing crisis.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek bitartekariak gabeko banakako jabetza zuzena ahalbidetzen du, guztientzako finantza-subiranotasuna sustatuz. Zure etxebizitza nagusitik haratago inbertsio gisa higiezinak erosteak etxebizitzaren finantzarizazioari laguntzen dio, etxeak ondasun gisa tratatuz aterpea baino. Honek prezioak igotzen ditu, familientzako irisgarritasuna murrizten du eta gaur egun herrialde askori eragiten dien etxebizitza eta etxerik gabeko krisian laguntzen du.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek norbanako bakoitzari jabetza indibidual zuzena ahalbidetzen dio. Higiezinak inbertsio gisa erostea, bizileku nagusiaz gain, etxebizitzen prezioak igotzen ditu, eskuragarritasuna murrizten du eta etxebizitza-krisia sortzen du.

entries.englishValueBefore: When you own Bitcoin, you have direct ownership of the asset itself. When you own stocks, you own a share of a company, which means your investment depends on the company's performance, management decisions, and business success.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a direct asset you own outright. Stocks are shares in a company — their value depends on management, performance, and decisions you can't control.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin duzunean, aktibo beraren zuzeneko jabetza duzu. Akzioak dituzunean, enpresa bateko partaidetza bat duzu, eta horrek esan nahi du zure inbertsioa enpresaren errendimenduan, kudeaketa-erabakietan eta negozio-arrakastaren menpe dagoela.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin zuzeneko ondasuna da, guztiz jabetzen duzuna. Akzioak enpresa bateko partaidetza dira — beren balioa zuzendaritzaren, etekinaren eta zuk kontrolatu ezin dituzun erabakien araberakoa da.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin operates on a decentralized network with no single point of failure. Stock investments are subject to key person risk - if the CEO or other critical leaders leave, get sick, or make poor decisions, your investment can suffer significantly. Companies depend heavily on their leadership teams.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has no CEO and no single point of failure. Stocks depend heavily on leadership — one bad decision or departure can tank the price.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin hutsegite puntu bakarrik gabeko sare deszentralizatu batean funtzionatzen du. Akzio-inbertsioak pertsona garrantzitsuen arriskuari lotuta daude - zuzendari nagusia edo beste lider garrantzitsua alde egiten badu, gaixotzen bada edo erabaki txarrak hartzen baditu, zure inbertsioak nabarmen kaltetu dezake. Enpresak oso menpekoak dira haien zuzendaritza-taldeekiko.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek ez du CEO-rik edo huts-puntu bakarrik. Akzioek zuzendaritzarekiko menpekotasun handia dute — erabaki txar batek edo pertsona giltzarriaren irteerak prezioa hondoratu dezake.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin's price is determined purely by market supply and demand. Stock prices are often evaluated using P/E ratios (Price-to-Earnings), which show how much investors pay for each dollar of company earnings. High P/E ratios can indicate overvalued stocks, making it harder to determine fair value.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin's price comes from open global markets. Stock valuations rely on metrics like P/E ratios that can mask overpriced shares.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-en prezioa soilik merkatuko eskaintza eta eskariaren arabera zehazten da. Akzio-prezioak sarritan P/E ratioen bidez (Prezioa-Irabaziak) ebaluatzen dira, eta horrek erakusten du inbertitzaileek zenbat ordaintzen duten enpresaren irabazi bakoitzarengatik. P/E ratio altuek akzio gehiegi baloratuak adieraz ditzakete, balio justua zehaztea zailagoa eginez.

entries.englishValue: A plain-English guide to accepting Bitcoin in your books — hybrid wallets, cost basis, capital gains, and when to call an accountant.

entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ordainketen kontabilitaterako gida sinplea — zorro hibridoak, kostu-oinarria, kapital-irabaziak eta noiz deitu zure kontulariari.

entries.englishValueBefore: Accepting Bitcoin has many benefits like accepting payments with lower fees & getting more customers.
entries.englishValue: The simplest way to accept Bitcoin is with a hybrid wallet that automatically sells 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars (or your local currency) the instant a payment comes in.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin onartzeak abantaila asko ditu, hala nola komisio baxuagoekin ordainketak onartzea eta bezero gehiago lortzea.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin onartzeko modurik errazena zorro hibrido bat erabiltzea da: jasotako Bitcoinaren % 100 automatikoki dolarretara (edo zure tokiko monetara) saltzen du, ordainketa iristen den bezain laster.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use a Hybrid Wallet from our Wallet Guide and automatically sell 100% of the Bitcoin you receive for dollars, you don't need to make any changes to your current accounting.
entries.englishValue: With this setup, your books look exactly like they do today — the final number is in dollars, every time. No cost basis, no capital gains, no new spreadsheets.
entries.currentValue: Gure zorro gidako zorro hibrido bat erabiltzen baduzu eta jasotzen duzun Bitcoin-aren %100 automatikoki dolarretara saltzen baduzu, ez duzu aldaketarik egin behar zure egungo kontabilitatean.
entries.targetTranslation: Konfigurazio horrekin, zure kontabilitatea gaur egungoaren berdina ikusten da — azken zenbatekoa dolarretan dago beti. Kostu-oinarririk ez, kapital-irabazirik ez, kalkulu-orri berririk ez.

entries.englishValueBefore: Tracking your cost basis is going to be the biggest difference between accounting for dollars and accounting for Bitcoin. Even if you view your business entirely in terms of Bitcoin, you need to report the dollar value of each transaction on your taxes.
entries.englishValue: Some businesses choose to keep a portion of the Bitcoin they receive instead of auto-converting it all. If that's you, the main extra step is tracking your cost basis — the dollar value of each Bitcoin payment on the day you received it.
entries.currentValue: Zure kostu oinarria jarraitzea izango da dolaren eta Bitcoin-en kontabilitatearen arteko desberdintasun handiena. Nahiz eta zure negozioa soilik Bitcoin terminoetan ikusten duzun, transakzio bakoitzaren dolar balioa adierazi behar duzu zure zergetan.
entries.targetTranslation: Enpresa batzuek jasotzen duten Bitcoinaren zati bat mantentzea erabakitzen dute, dena automatikoki bihurtu beharrean. Zu horietako bat bazara, urrats gehigarria kostu-oinarria jarraitzea da — Bitcoin ordainketa bakoitzaren dolar-balioa jaso zenuen egunean.

entries.englishValueBefore: If you use QuickBooks, you can do this automatically using the Bitcoin Sync plugin.
entries.englishValue: Even if you think of your business entirely in Bitcoin, most tax authorities still want the dollar value reported. The good news: it's just two numbers per transaction — the amount of Bitcoin received and its dollar value on that day.
entries.currentValue: QuickBooks erabiltzen baduzu, hau automatikoki egin dezakezu Bitcoin Sync plugina erabiliz.
entries.targetTranslation: Zure enpresan Bitcoinetan soilik pentsatzen baduzu ere, zerga-agintaritza gehienek dolar-balioa ere jakinaraztea eskatzen dute. Albiste ona: bi zenbaki besterik ez dira transakzio bakoitzeko — jasotako Bitcoin kopurua eta egun horretako dolar-balioa.

entries.englishValueBefore: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. This makes your money worth less over time.
entries.englishValue: Inflation happens when more money is printed or created from thin air. That makes the money in your pocket worth less over time — and it's why prices keep going up year after year.
entries.currentValue: Inflazioa diru gehiago inprimatzen edo ezerezetik sortzen denean gertatzen da. Honek zure dirua gutxiago balio du denborarekin.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has a fixed supply, which means no one can print more Bitcoin.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin has a fixed supply of 21 million coins. No government, bank, or company can print more of it. Your Bitcoin savings hold their value over time instead of quietly losing it.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek eskaintza finko bat du, eta horrek esan nahi du inork ezin duela Bitcoin gehiago inprimatu.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinek eskaintza finkoa du: 21 milioi moneta. Ezein gobernu, banku edo enpresak ezin du gehiago inprimatu. Bitcoinetan dituzun aurrezkiek balioa mantentzen dute denborarekin, isilean galdu beharrean.

entries.englishValueBefore: Multiple US banks have collapsed in the past few years due to bank runs.
entries.englishValue: Multiple U.S. banks have collapsed in recent years because of bank runs. When too many customers tried to withdraw at once, the banks didn't have the cash to pay everyone back.
entries.currentValue: AEBetako hainbat banku erori dira azken urteetan banku-ihesen ondorioz.
entries.targetTranslation: Azken urteotan AEBetako banku asko hondoratu dira banku-ihesen eraginez. Bezero gehiegik batera dirua atera nahi izan zutenean, bankuek ez zuten nahikoa eskudiru guztiei ordaintzeko.

entries.englishValueBefore: Instead of just holding your money for you, banks invest and lend out your money. If those investments don't do well, they don't have enough to pay you back.
entries.englishValue: Instead of just holding your money, banks lend and invest most of it. If those investments go bad — or if depositors lose confidence — the bank can fail, and your deposits can be frozen or lost.
entries.currentValue: Zure dirua zuretzat gordetzeko ordez, bankuek zure dirua inbertitu eta maileguan ematen dute. Inbertsio horiek ondo ez badoaz, ez dute nahikoa zuri itzultzeko.
entries.targetTranslation: Zure dirua gordetzeaz gain, bankuek horren zati handi bat mailegatzen eta inbertitzen dute. Inbertsio horiek huts egiten badute — edo gordailugileek konfiantza galtzen badute — bankua hondoratu daiteke eta zure gordailuak izoztu edo galdu egin daitezke.

entries.englishValueBefore: And the FDIC insurance fund only has $1 for every $100 they're insuring.
entries.englishValue: With Bitcoin, you can hold your own money directly in your own wallet. No bank. No intermediary. No bank run.
entries.currentValue: Eta FDIC aseguru funtsak $1 besterik ez du aseguratzen duten $100 bakoitzeko.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoinekin zure dirua zure zorroan zuzenean mantendu dezakezu. Bankurik ez. Bitartekaririk ez. Banku-iheserik ez.

entries.englishValueBefore: Unlike traditional financial networks, Bitcoin doesn't require permission to be used.
entries.englishValue: Unlike credit cards, PayPal, or traditional bank accounts, Bitcoin doesn't require anyone's permission to use.
entries.currentValue: Finantza-sare tradizionalek ez bezala, Bitcoin-ek ez du baimenik behar erabiltzeko.
entries.targetTranslation: Kreditu-txartelek, PayPal-ek edo banku-kontu tradizionalek ez bezala, Bitcoinek ez du inoren baimenik behar.

entries.englishValueBefore: That means no one can stop you from using Bitcoin for any reason. It's the first financial network you can use without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.englishValue: No one can freeze your account, block a payment, or cut you off from the network. It's the first financial system in history you can use freely, without fear of censorship or seizure.
entries.currentValue: Horrek esan nahi du inork ezin dizula Bitcoin erabiltzea galarazi inolako arrazoirengatik. Zentsura edo konfiskaziorik gabe erabil dezakezun lehen finantza-sarea da.
entries.targetTranslation: Inork ezin du zure kontua izoztu, ordainketa bat blokeatu edo saretik kanporatu. Historian lehen finantza-sistema da erabili ahal duzuna, zentsura edo konfiskazioaren beldurrik gabe.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin is a misunderstood technology that is building a better world.
entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is often misunderstood, but it's quietly doing a lot of good in the world.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin gaizki ulertutako teknologia bat da, mundu hobea eraikitzen ari dena.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin sarritan gaizki ulertua izaten da, baina isilean gauza on asko egiten du munduan.

entries.englishValueBefore: Bitcoin has enabled human rights activists to fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions, saved national parks, and so much more.
entries.englishValue: It has helped human rights activists fight for freedom, reduced global methane emissions from landfills and oil fields, stabilized electric grids, and funded public goods like national parks.
entries.currentValue: Bitcoin-ek giza eskubideen aktibistei askatasunaren alde borrokatzea ahalbidetu die, metano emisio globalak murriztu ditu, parke nazionalak salbatu ditu, eta askoz gehiago.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is a full-reserve system. You're not depositing your money in a bank. You are your own bank. There's no lending out your money without your knowledge because you are the only one who can access your money.

entries.englishValue: Thousands of businesses couldn't pay their employees. The FDIC stepped in — but that raised a bigger question: is your money actually safe?

entries.englishValue: Banks don't hold your deposits in a vault. They lend your money out and invest it — that's called fractional reserve banking.

entries.englishValue: If too many people try to withdraw at the same time, the bank doesn't have enough cash to pay everyone. That's a bank run — and it can cause banks to collapse entirely.
entries.targetTranslation: Jende gehiegik batera dirua atera nahi duenean, bankuak ez du nahikoa eskudiru guztiei ordaintzeko. Hori da banku-ihesa — eta bankuaren erabateko hondoratzera eraman dezake.

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin at your business doesn't have to complicate your accounting. Here's the short version — plus the tools and pros to make it painless.
entries.targetTranslation: Zure enpresan Bitcoin onartzeak ez du zertan zure kontabilitatea konplikatu. Hona hemen bertsio laburra — gehi erraztuko duten tresnak eta adituak.

entries.englishValue: If you already accept cash or card, adding Bitcoin to your business books is simpler than it looks. You have two paths: auto-convert every Bitcoin payment to dollars the moment it arrives (no new accounting needed), or keep some as Bitcoin (a few extra numbers to track).
entries.targetTranslation: Dagoeneko eskudirua edo txartelak onartzen badituzu, zure enpresaren kontabilitatera Bitcoin gehitzea uste baino errazagoa da. Bi bide dituzu: Bitcoin ordainketa bakoitza automatikoki dolarretara bihurtzea iristen den bezain laster (kontabilitate berririk ez behar), edo zati bat Bitcoinetan mantentzea (zenbaki gehigarri batzuk jarraitu behar dituzu).

entries.englishValue: This guide walks you through both — so you can pick the one that fits your business and start accepting Bitcoin with confidence.
entries.targetTranslation: Gida honek bi bideak azaltzen ditu — zure enpresarako egokia aukeratu ahal izateko eta konfiantzarekin Bitcoin onartzen hasteko.

entries.englishValue: We'll create and publish your sticker files within 3 to 4 weeks. Once they're ready, you'll be able to download and print them for free from our sticker files page.

entries.englishValue: Sticker files are released in batches, so it may take a few weeks for your language to go live. Thanks for your patience!

entries.englishValue: If 3 stickers aren't enough for your business, feel free to request another free pack — or order in bulk from the same printer we use.

entries.englishValue: Let your customers know you accept Bitcoin. Order a free pack of 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers to put up at your business.

entries.englishValue: Free 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin is only half the job — your customers also need to know that you do. These small 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers are designed to stick on your front door, register, menu, or anywhere else customers will see them before they pay.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin onartzea lanaren erdia baino ez da — zure bezeroek ere jakin behar dute. «Hemen Bitcoin onartzen dugu» pegatina txiki hauek atari nagusiaren, kutxaren, menuaren edo bezeroek ordaintzen duten edozein lekuen ondoan jartzeko diseinatuta daude.

entries.englishValue: You can print your own 'Bitcoin Accepted Here' stickers, no matter where you live. Click your language below to download the sticker files and printing instructions.

entries.englishValue: All Bitcoin wallets are interoperable — pick the one that fits your business. Free, instant settlement, no chargebacks.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin zorro guztiek elkarrekin funtzionatzen dute — aukeratu zure enpresarako egokiena. Doan, istantaneoko likidazioekin, itzulketarik gabe.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin wallets are free. Pick one that fits your business — in-person, online, or invoice-based — and start accepting Bitcoin in minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin zorroak doakoak dira. Aukeratu zure enpresarako egokiena — presentzialki, online edo faktura bidez — eta hasi Bitcoin onartzen minutu gutxitan.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for invoice-based businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Bezeroei faktura egiten dieten enpresentzako zorroak

entries.englishValue: If you invoice clients (consulting, freelancing, B2B services), use a wallet built around invoicing. Your client pays a Bitcoin invoice in a couple of clicks.
entries.targetTranslation: Bezeroei faktura egiten badiezu (aholkularitza, lan autonomoa, B2B zerbitzuak), erabili faktura-ingurunean eraikitako zorro bat. Bezeroak Bitcoin faktura ordainduko du klik gutxi batzuekin.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for businesses with multiple employees
entries.targetTranslation: Langile ugariko enpresentzako zorroak

entries.englishValue: If you have a team taking payments at the register, choose a wallet that supports multiple employee logins — so every employee gets their own PIN and you keep a clean audit trail of who took which payment.
entries.targetTranslation: Kutxan ordainketak jasotzen dituen taldea baduzu, aukeratu langile anitzen saioa onartzen duen zorroa — langile bakoitzak bere PINa izan dezan eta zeinek zein ordainketa jaso duen argi jarrai dezazun.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for online businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Online enpresentzako zorroak

entries.englishValue: Selling on a website? These wallets plug into your online store and accept Bitcoin from any customer, anywhere in the world — no chargebacks, no merchant account required.
entries.targetTranslation: Online saltzen ari zara? Zorro hauek zure sareko dendarekin konektatzen dira eta mundu osoko bezero guztien Bitcoin ordainketak onartzen dituzte — itzulketarik gabe eta merkatari-konturik behar ez izan gabe.

entries.englishValue: Wallets for individually-owned businesses
entries.targetTranslation: Enpresaburu bakarrarentzako zorroak

entries.englishValue: If you run a shop, café, studio, or service on your own, any of these wallets will work. Pick based on whether you want to keep payments in Bitcoin or auto-convert part of each payment to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Denda, kafetegia, estudioa edo zerbitzua bakarrik kudeatzen baduzu, zorro hauetako edozein aproposa da zuretzat. Aukeratu Bitcoin ordainketak mantendu nahi dituzun ala ordainketa bakoitzaren zati bat automatikoki zure tokiko monetara bihurtu.

entries.englishValue: Strike Business lets you accept Bitcoin and Lightning payments with zero fees and instant settlement. Supports in-person, online, and invoice-based payments with optional auto-conversion to your local currency.
entries.targetTranslation: Strike Business-ek Bitcoin eta Lightning ordainketak kuotarik gabe eta istantaneoko likidazioekin onartzen uzten dizu. Presentziako, online eta faktura bidezko ordainketak onartzen ditu, tokiko monetara automatikoki bihurtzeko aukerarekin.

entries.englishValue: Lower fees, more for the business
entries.targetTranslation: Kuota baxuagoak, enpresarentzat gehiago

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments skip the banks and credit card companies that take 2–3% from every sale. The business keeps more of what you pay — which often means better prices and better service for you.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ordainketek salmenta bakoitzaren % 2–3 hartzen duten bankuak eta txartel-konpainiak saihesten dituzte. Enpresak ordaintzen duzunetik gehiago mantentzen du — horrek zuretzat prezio hobeak eta zerbitzu hobea esan nahi dute maiz.

entries.englishValue: Instant settlement, no chargebacks
entries.targetTranslation: Istantaneoko likidazioa, itzulketarik gabe

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin payments settle in seconds, directly from your wallet to the business. There's no waiting days for a bank to release funds, and no costly chargeback disputes — so the business can focus on serving customers instead of fighting fraud.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ordainketak segundoetan likidatzen dira, zuzenean zure zorrotik enpresara. Ez duzu egunak itxaron behar bankuak dirua askatu arte, eta ez daude itzulketa-eztabaida garestirik — horrek esan nahi du enpresak bezeroei arreta eman diezaiekeela, iruzurrarekin borrokatu beharrean.

entries.englishValue: Free to accept, open to everyone
entries.targetTranslation: Doako onarpena, denontzat irekia

entries.englishValue: There are no contracts, monthly fees, or setup costs for a business to accept Bitcoin. And millions of Bitcoin users around the world actively seek out merchants that accept it — giving this business free exposure to new customers.
entries.targetTranslation: Enpresarentzat Bitcoin onartzeak ez du kontraturik, hileroko kuotarik edo abiarazte-kosturik behar. Eta mundu osoko milioika Bitcoin erabiltzailek onartzen duten merkatariak aktiboki bilatzen ari dira — enpresa horri ikusgarritasun doakoa emanez bezero berrientzat.

entries.englishValue: Why Bitcoin is great for this business
entries.targetTranslation: Zergatik da ona Bitcoin enpresa honentzat

entries.englishValue: Accepting Bitcoin lets a business keep more of every sale, get paid instantly with no chargebacks, and reach a global audience of Bitcoin users — all with zero contracts and zero monthly fees.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin onartuz, enpresa honek salmenta bakoitzaren gehiago mantentzen du, ordainketak istantean jasotzen ditu itzulketarik gabe eta Bitcoin erabiltzaileen audientzia globala iristen du — kontraturik edo hileroko kuotarik gabe.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin isn't just useful at the cash register — it's a better form of money that protects your savings, your privacy, and your freedom to transact. Here's a quick overview.
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin ez da ona kutxan bakarrik — diru-mota hobea da, zure aurrezkiak, pribatutasuna eta transakzioak egiteko askatasuna babesten dituena. Hona hemen laburpen azkarra.

entries.englishValue: You just scanned a Bitcoin Accepted Here sticker. Here's why that's great news — for this business, and for you.
entries.targetTranslation: «Hemen Bitcoin onartzen dugu» pegatina bat eskaneatu berri duzu. Hona hemen zergatik den albiste ona — enpresa honentzat eta zuretzat.

entries.englishValue: The business you're at accepts Bitcoin — a modern, open-source payment network that anyone can use, anywhere in the world, without banks or middlemen taking a cut.
entries.targetTranslation: Zauden enpresak Bitcoin onartzen du — ordainketa-sare moderno, kode irekikoa, mundu osoko edonork erabili dezakeena, bankuek eta bitartekariek zati bat hartu gabe.

entries.englishValue: Below is the short version of why accepting Bitcoin is good for this business, plus why using Bitcoin is good for you as a customer.
entries.targetTranslation: Behean enpresa honek Bitcoin onartzea zergatik den ona bertsio laburra dago, gehi bezero gisa Bitcoin erabiltzea zergatik den ona zuretzat.

entries.englishValue: Flyers are one of the easiest ways to introduce Bitcoin to your community. Download a free printable Bitcoin flyer, print as many copies as you'd like, and post them on community boards, in coffee shops, at meetups, or anywhere else people gather.
entries.targetTranslation: Esku-orriak dira zure komunitatean Bitcoin aurkezteko modurik errazenetako bat. Deskargatu gure doako inprimagarri den Bitcoin esku-orria, inprimatu nahi beste kopia eta jarri iragarki-tauletan, kafetegietan, bileretan edo jendea biltzen den edozein lekutan.

entries.englishValue: Each flyer includes a compelling headline and a QR code that sends curious readers to bitcoin.rocks to learn more.
entries.targetTranslation: Esku-orri bakoitzak begirada hartzen duen titulua du eta QR kode bat, gogotsuak diren irakurleak bitcoin.rocks-era zuzentzen dituena, gehiago jakiteko.

entries.englishValue: Unlike stickers, flyers can be printed on demand from anywhere in the world — all you need is a printer and a few minutes.
entries.targetTranslation: Pegatinek ez bezala, esku-orriak eskaeran inprimatu daitezke munduko edozein lekuan — inprimagailua eta minutu batzuk baino ez dituzu behar.

entries.englishValue: bitcoin.rocks is a free, open-source project licensed under the MIT License. Our mission is to accelerate Bitcoin adoption through education — and we can't do it alone.

entries.englishValue: Whether you're a developer, designer, writer, or translator, there's a way for you to help. We especially welcome contributors who can translate our content into more languages so more people around the world can learn about Bitcoin in their native tongue.
entries.targetTranslation: Garatzailea, diseinatzailea, idazlea edo itzultzailea bazara, laguntzeko modua dago. Bereziki itxaroten ditugu gure edukiak hizkuntza gehiagotara itzuli ditzaketenak, mundu osoko jendeak Bitcoini buruz ikasi ahal izateko beren ama-hizkuntzan.

entries.englishValue: Fork the repository, open a pull request, file an issue, or just star the project to show your support. Every contribution helps Bitcoin reach more people.
entries.targetTranslation: Egin gure biltegiaren fork-a, ireki pull request bat, sortu issue bat edo eman proiektuari izarra. Ekarpen bakoitzak Bitcoin jende gehiagori iristen laguntzen dio.

entries.englishValue: Nostr clients are free apps that let you read and post on the Nostr network. All of them are interoperable — you can switch clients anytime and keep your followers and content.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr bezeroak Nostr sarea irakurtzeko eta idazteko aukera ematen duten doako aplikazioak dira. Guztiek elkarrekin funtzionatzen dute — edozein unetan bezeroak alda ditzakezu eta zure jarraitzaileak eta edukia mantendu.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new decentralized protocol for communicating online — no single company controls it, Bitcoin zaps are built in, and you can move between apps without losing your followers.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr webeko komunikaziorako protokolo deszentralizatu berria da — inolako enpresak ez du jabetzen, Bitcoin zap-ak integratuta ditu eta aplikazioen artean aldatu zaitezke jarraitzaileak galdu gabe.

entries.englishValue: What is Nostr?
entries.targetTranslation: Zer da Nostr?

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email: no one owns the protocol, anyone can build an app on top of it, and you can pick whichever app you like best. Unlike Twitter or Facebook, there's no central company that can censor, deplatform, or deboost you.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr posta elektronikoaren antzekoa da: protokoloak ez du inor jabe, edonork eraiki dezake aplikazio bat hari gainean eta zuk aukeratzen duzu zuretzat egokiena dena. Twitter edo Facebook ez bezala, ez dago enpresa zentralik zure kontuak zentsuratu, kaleratu edo isilarazi ahal izateko.

entries.englishValue: Nostr is a new protocol that lets you communicate online without fear of censorship, deplatforming, or deboosting.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr webean komunikatzeko aukera ematen duen protokolo berria da, zentsuraren, debekuaren edo isilarazketaren beldurrik gabe.

entries.englishValue: Platforms like Twitter and Facebook are controlled by a single company, but no one controls the Nostr protocol.
entries.targetTranslation: Twitter edo Facebook bezalako plataformak enpresa baten kontrolpean daude, baina Nostr protokoloa ez dago inoren kontrolpean.

entries.englishValue: Freedom to move
entries.targetTranslation: Mugitzeko askatasuna

entries.englishValue: Nostr is similar to email. No one controls the email protocol, and anyone can build a client (like Gmail, Hotmail, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr posta elektronikoaren antzekoa da. Inork ez du kontrolatzen posta elektronikoaren protokoloa eta edonork eraiki dezake bezero bat (Gmail, Hotmail, etab. bezala).

entries.englishValue: No one controls the Nostr protocol either, and anyone can build a client (like Damus, Amethyst, etc.) on top of it.
entries.targetTranslation: Nostr protokoloa ere ez dago inoren kontrolpean eta edonork eraiki dezake bezero bat (Damus, Amethyst, etab. bezala).

entries.englishValue: If you don't like how a certain client works, you can seamlessly move your Nostr account to another client without losing your followers or content.
entries.targetTranslation: Bezero jakin batek nola funtzionatzen duen gustatzen ez bazaizu, zure Nostr kontua beste bezero batera eraman dezakezu, jarraitzaileak edo edukia galdu gabe.

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin integratuta dago

entries.englishValue: Bitcoin is built in natively to the Nostr protocol. If you see content you like, you can easily zap Bitcoin to someone as a thank you!
entries.targetTranslation: Bitcoin Nostr protokoloan integratuta dago. Gustuko duzun edukia ikusten duzunean, autoreari «Bitcoin zap bat» bidal diezaiokezu esker gisa.

entries.englishValue: On centralized platforms like Twitter and Facebook, the centralized company earns money from your content. But on open protocols like Nostr, you earn money from your content.
entries.targetTranslation: Twitter eta Facebook bezalako plataforma zentralizatuetan, enpresa zentralak dirua ateratzen du zure edukitik. Baina Nostr bezalako protokolo irekietan, zuk ateratzen duzu dirua zure edukitik.
